# libretro-common vendor directory

My parser and emitter in `retroarch.rs` is based on the source code of `config_file.{h,c}` in this directory. Since the repository has no tags, I extracted the sources from [this commit](https://github.com/libretro/libretro-common/commit/a0403d4273fbd5ce6971f6f41c90c6df2b02e14b).
